interpretation_guide.not_in_stored_provider_payload: The stored fixture response did not contain a statistics field; this does not by itself prove the provider has no statistics.
interpretation_guide.provider_returned_empty_statistics: The stored provider response explicitly contained an empty statistics list.
interpretation_guide.provider_payload_contains_statistics: The stored response included a non-empty statistics payload; if normalized rows are zero, investigate the importer.
interpretation_guide.completed_scored: Recognized completed status, both scores present, and kickoff is in the past.
